name: io.github.engmohammeda/edutube-mcp
description: Edutube MCP: turn YouTube playlists and videos into structured lessons, analyses, frames and quizzes with Google Gemini and automatic model rotation

environmentVariables.description: YouTube Data API v3 key (optional; speeds playlist import and enables get_youtube_video_metadata).
environmentVariables.name: YOUTUBE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated model rotation order for free-tier quota pools.
environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_MODEL_ROTATION

environmentVariables.description: Optional default directory for extracted lesson JSON files.
environmentVariables.name: EDUTUBE_OUTPUT_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a yt-dlp executable.
environmentVariables.name: YT_DLP_PATH
